tips.text: Rank one Lato and one Bolto to 30 before crafting them onward; otherwise you rebuild one later for that Mastery.
Rank the Akbolto to 30 before you spend it on an Akjagara.
Start both Bolto builds first and farm Orokin Cells and Neurodes while the timers run.
Nobody discusses the farm; it is materials and waiting, with Orokin Cells the only gatekeeper.
